label: Paper sketchbook hero
desc: An illustrator's portfolio built as a paper world: drawn SVG plates on warm paper, a sketchbook whose pages turn by drag or arrow keys with a 3D leaf and travelling shade, a magnifier loupe over the artwork, a filterable commissions index, a rates dialog and a validated contact form.
use: illustrator, artist or designer portfolio; any personal site that should feel handmade

label: Bookshelf studio hero
desc: A studio portfolio whose first screen is a lit room: a full-width oak shelf of seven CSS 3D books with a pooled spotlight (daylight library or lamp-lit study), drag, arrow keys or a magnifying dock to pull one forward and show its cover, a detail strip with working actions, a stacking method section, catalogue dialog, journal accordion and a validated booking form.
use: studio, product or tool-maker portfolio; any catalogue of a handful of items
